notes.title: PC Patch Notes: v1.0.1.1
notes.content: [h3]🥕🍅 [b]PC Patch Notes: v1.0.1.1[/b] 🥕🍅[/h3][list][*][p]It took a bit of convincing, but Sandyman's finally come around and will now properly acknowledge that you've done every last task he set, and he's handed over all the rewards he promised.[/p][/*][*][p]If your PC contraption is not the fastest in Westfarthing, worry not. Conversations with folk around Bywater now load a bit faster.[/p][/*][*][p]The Cooking Club's Level 5 achievement is now unlocking for all Hobbits. Even Old Noakes might smile about this.[/p][/*][*][p]The quantity picker in the Transfer Storage menu will no longer show you disappearing items, if you've ever heard of such a thing.[/p][/*][*][p]We're terribly sorry some of your neighbours were still sending disgruntled letters on the very day you planned a nice, shared meal. We've had another gentle word about meal etiquette.[/p][/*][*][p]Moving items to your backpack won't lose them anymore, even if your pantry is as well-stocked as most pantries are in this corner of Middle-earth.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: PC Patch Notes: v1.0.1.0
notes.content: [p]Hullo Hobbits,[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience as we pruned, spruced, weeded, planted and tended to all sorts of things in the garden for our new PC patch — released today![/p][p][/p][h3]🥕🍅 [b]PC Patch Notes: v1.0.1.0[/b] 🥕🍅[/h3][list][*][p]We've adjusted the quality needed for certain club hand-ins.[/p][/*][*][p]A proper shared meal needs more than just good ingredients. It also relies on letters arriving exactly when they should, and your meal not being skipped.[/p][/*][*][p]A bothersome bug had Old Noakes casting his line in the oddest of places. The master angler is now back fishing where he knows best.[/p][/*][*][p]Some items placed outside of one's home were disappearing without so much as a goodbye. This mystery has been cleared up, and everything should stay right where you left it.[/p][/*][*][p]In more good news, there have been some shader loading improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]Browsing your pantry and admiring all of your fine produce is now even smoother (thanks to improved UI at certain resolutions).[/p][/*][*][p]You might not have noticed an unsightly seam in that lovely yellow shirt, but our artists certainly did.[/p][/*][*][p]Some garden beds were holding onto more water than they ought. Everything’s draining properly now.[/p][/*][*][p]The placement of some decorations was a bit out of sorts. They've been nudged back into place.[/p][/*][*][p]On Steam Deck, Bywater's townsfolk had a habit of stacking up on one another. We've given them a gentle reminder about gravity and boundaries.[/p][/*][*][p]Some text was turning up larger than expected. It's now back to its usual, more polite size.[/p][/*][*][p]The game was being unhelpfully stubborn when backing out of the Exit Game prompt. It’s now quick to respond, just like a Hobbit when offered pie.[/p][/*][*][p]Some Hobbits found their arms could clip through beehives. It's been sorted, and the bees are very relieved.[/p][/*][*][p]On Steam Deck, the virtual keyboard is now much more well-mannered and should now always be raised when needed on the name screen.[/p][/*][*][p]The birds are finding their way more sensibly around newly unlocked garden beds.[/p][/*][*][p]No more decorations floating about mid-air. They'll now stay put on that nice table or shelf, just as they should.[/p][/*][*][p]Some of the tables were being fussy about exactly where decorations should sit. They'll now be more accommodating.[/p][/*][*][p]Old Noakes's undergarments (if you know, dear Hobbit, you know) have now been kindly restored to their proper location.[/p][/*][*][p]As his tale unfolds, master angler Old Noakes will remain where he's most content: perched by (or in!) a body of water.[/p][/*][*][p]Some UI buttons were proving to be a little troublesome, remaining visible after they should have disappeared.[/p][/*][*][p]Hobbits can go to bed soundly (without UI issues) after another beautiful day in The Shire.[/p][/*][*][p]Some Hobbits found they were being terribly impolite by falling asleep while in conversation with good company.[/p][/*][*][p]We've been out in the garden with some compost (or, what we like to call performance improvements) to make plants grow even better.[/p][/*][*][p]Barley kept turning up in the chicken trough, though the hens didn't seem to mind.[/p][/*][*][p]The hens were doing their part, but their eggs were in a muddle. Worry not, breakfast is back on track![/p][/*][*][p]The snow is beautiful here, but a bit of a nuisance when it's inside your home. Rest assured, you won't see any more flakes falling above your furniture.[/p][/*][*][p]We've oiled some hinges so that it's quicker to swap between the tools of your choosing, be they mouse and keyboard or controller.[/p][/*][*][p]We've spruced up how some special fonts made their first appearance.[/p][/*][*][p]Hobbits might notice highlighting fixes in the decorations menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Some decorative items aren't quite suited to the kitchen.[/p][/*][*][p]A strange cube was causing a bit of a stir in The Shire.[/p][/*][*][p]Moving trees were keenly spotted in The Shire. Not Ents, mind you, but rather a curious phenomenon that we've tended to.[/p][/*][*][p]The sound of footsteps has been softened slightly. Your Hobbit feet now tread a bit more gently.[/p][/*][*][p]In some cutscenes, the camera took an unexpected detour underground into the good, tilled earth.[/p][/*][*][p]We've adjusted the order in which items are loaded from your game save, like laying out the perfect picnic.[/p][/*][*][p]A small hiccup with arrow keys and shared meal locations has been tidied.[/p][/*][*][p]Some UI was disappearing much too quickly when loading a save.[/p][/*][*][p]No more rummaging about, your pantry now selects the first item when you open it.[/p][/*][*][p]There should be no more performance stumbles when you're using your watering can to tend to your taters — or anything else you're busy growing.[/p][/*][*][p]Some folks found themselves falling asleep after entering certain Act III tales, only to wake and discover they couldn't carry on.[/p][/*][*][p]Best to be inside when choosing some stylish attire. You can no longer open your wardrobe from outside of your home.[/p][/*][*][p]A good Hobbit name is like a good meal: unforgettable. Our UI will now remember your custom name should you return to character customisation. has a kind heart — one that'll always welcome you to Bywater, even if you stop and reload the game immediately after you customise your Hobbit.[/p][/*][*][p]Camera sensitivity has been tinkered downwards a bit when using your mouse.[/p][/*][*][p]The birds are wonderfully helpful guides, but not when they're guiding you through locked gates and doors. We've had a quiet word with them about choosing better routes.[/p][/*][*][p]No more waiting around for a friendly word; NPC dialogue will now load more quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]A Hobbit home is all about comfort, and it's certainly not comforting finding yourself underneath those nicely tiled floors of yours. You can rest easy knowing you'll wake up safe and sound inside your home.[/p][/*][*][p]It is now easier to select all shared meal locations when using a keyboard and mouse... the kind of news that will get the whole village talking.[/p][/*][*][p]A moderately full pantry will no longer be a bother to navigate while using a controller.[/p][/*][*][p]Even The Shire welcomes a little rain — it makes things bloom, after all! Rainy days are forecast to return between years 3 and 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Hobbits speaking Chinese, Japanese and Korean will find things running smoother from the start of their time in Bywater.[/p][/*][*][p]Befriend Young Tom Cotton and he'll share some goods both rare and wonderous.[/p][/*][*][p]You'll now be able to complete the final chapter of your relationship with Sandyman. Of course, as any Hobbit knows, a good friendship is never really finished; it simply carries on, one tasty, shared meal at a time.[/p][/*][*][p]Hobbits can now reduce depth-of-field settings in the Graphics menu. We hope this helps our dear friends who were experiencing a spot of motion sickness.[/p][/*][*][p]The pantry has been given a tidy and is now better at distinguishing when you're simply rearranging your stores or removing something for good.[/p][/*][*][p]There's nothing quite like the sound of rain while warm at home. Now, rainfall can be heard more evenly throughout your Hobbit Hole.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: PC Patch Notes: v1.0.0.2
notes.content: [p]Hello Hobbits,[/p][p]Thank you for your support of Tales of the Shire! The team has been working on bugs and issues that have popped up since launch:[/p][list][*][p]In later years, some players have found forageables increasingly scarce. Bywater's fields and forests should be full of treasures, so we've rolled up our sleeves to bring back this bounty, amending the fixed spawn rate of forageables in Year 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Butterfly Cups were proving to be quite elusive. Worry not, we've addressed an issue with the spawn rate of these particular nighttime mushrooms.[/p][/*][*][p]We've fixed a bug that prevented Hobbits from scrolling to the bottom of the pantry list while using a controller. Everything's back in order, from top shelf to bottom basket.[/p][/*][*][p]The shared meal location selection should now allow Hobbits to select all locations when using the mouse, so you can set the table wherever your Hobbit heart desires.[/p][/*][/list][p]Additionally, we previously put out a small patch (v1.0.0.1) addressing save game file visbility:[/p][list][*][p]Resolved an issue where the Load Game screen appeared empty, causing some Hobbits to fear their precious saves had been lost to the wind.[/p][/*][/list][p]We will continue to monitor for any ongoing and new issues here and on our Discord![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44989720/4f4015d67d59dbace2f6edcfc2fac8a3e6d4b6e2.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of The Rings Game (PS5) Review
notes.content:
Ever since reading The Hobbit at 10 years old, I’ve been able to see the appeal of Tolkien’s halflings’ lifestyle—which Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of The Rings Game aims to adapt into a cozy life sim.

After all, who lives cozier than Hobbits? They live in modest comforts, in touch with the earth, walking a balance between leisure and humble work. In a lot of ways (not including that nasty war and “One Ring to bind them” nonsense), the world of Tolkien’s legendarium is a perfect fit for this thriving game genre.

And now, at long last, Tales of the Shire has arrived to make (mostly) good on that promise and potential.

Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of The Rings Game is the latest in a long line of cozy games where players create an in-game persona and pursue the simpler things in life. No dodges and parries here; the only boss is the unescapable sense of pressure to keep improving your relationships, bank account, and yield quality.... Read more

notes.title: New Gameplay Trailer Premieres At Wholesome Direct 2025
notes.content:
[p]Hello Hobbits,[/p][p]At the Wholesome Direct last weekend, we welcomed viewers home to The Shire in a brand-new trailer for the [b][i]Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of the Rings™ Game[/i][/b] featuring charming gameplay, serene surroundings, and in true Hobbit fashion – plenty of food.[/p][p]The new trailer gives glimpses of life in Bywater, meeting new friends and familiar faces. Decorate your own Hobbit hole, exactly as you like, and enjoy the simple pleasures of life in The Shire. Bask in colourful seasonal changes as you stock up your pantry by fishing, gardening, foraging and trading ingredients for shared meals with friends. Your fellow Hobbits don’t need an excuse for a party, they’re just waiting for your invitation….only when you’re ready, of course![/p][p]You can check out the full trailer below.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="XabBAJdc964;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[b][i]Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of the Rings™ Game [/i][/b]launches July 29th. Make sure to add it to your wishlist if you haven't yet![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2016460/Tales_of_the_Shire_A_The_Lord_of_The_Rings_Game/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of The Rings™ Game now launching 29 July 2025
notes.content:
Dear Fellow Hobbits,

A good Hobbit feast takes time, and so does [i]Tales of the Shire[/i]! We're taking a little longer to ensure that every Hobbit, on every platform, can enjoy the same cosy experience. The game will now launch on [b]29th July 2025[/b].

We want this game to feel like a warm hug from Middle-earth, and we are making sure that no matter what you play, you'll feel right at home in The Shire. From foot-hair styles to the fluffiest cakes, every detail will be just right.

We appreciate your patience and cannot wait for you to experience life in The Shire this summer. In the meantime, arrange the table, polish your sliver and get ready for a feast fit for a Hobbit!

Looking forward to welcoming you to Bywater.

- From the folks at Wētā Workshop Game Studio
